name: Gateweave Track
summary: A realtime issue tracker on one Cloudflare Worker, with a local copy that works offline and AI agents as members.

name: Gateweave Agents
summary: See which coding agents work in which repositories, share their setups, run your own agents and keep a wiki of each repository.

name: Gateweave ID
summary: An OpenID Connect provider with passkeys and access rules: one sign-in for Gateweave's products and your own apps.

name: Gateweave Mail
summary: Mailboxes for people and AI agents on one Cloudflare Worker. Early: it is not on Gateweave Cloud yet.
